verdict.tagline: Build rockets, embrace fiery explosions, and finally reach orbit.
for_you_if: you enjoy tackling complex engineering and orbital mechanics
you are ready to learn through spectacular failures
you want an expansive experience enhanced by mods
not_for_you_if: you are frustrated by steep learning curves
you want a game free of performance drops
you dislike relying on trial and error

this game is amazing. it may be old, and the graphics may be bad, but there are plenty of free mods that will make you feel like you are playing a game that just came out. while it may seem boring that you just build and launch rockets, the flight is more than just w a s d movement. while it can seem hard at times, it allows you to restart the launch so really cant loose your progress. thats another thing, the game makes it seem hard, so when you splash down your first rocket, orbit kermin, or land on the mun, you feel a rush of pride and exeliration that no other game can match. theres a reason you see the people at huston jumping up and down when neil armstrong landed on earth's moon, and in this game, you get that too. on top of all of this, you can basically find a mod for anything you want to add, and CKAN makes it insanely easy to do so. the kerbals are also halarious, and you can sometimes get attached to the little guys. amazing game, 11/10, strongly reccomend.

citations.review_text:
With Mods, this game is magnificant. You can do almost everything, and it just tickles that itch to send somebody on a 100+ year journey to outer space on a orbital Lawn Chair. But only with mods. Withoutmods, the game is still good, but i would recomend at least visual mods 100% of the time.
Rest In Peace, Jeb

Let me start by saying I absolutely love this game. It is by no means perfect but I love it regardless. Been playing this game since Early Access around update 0.19 and have logged around 2100 hours across various saves so please ignore Steam's play time counter as much was done through the game .exe file. 

This game continues to this day to be my favorite game of all time and one that I keep coming back to both for fun and as a comfort when life gets stressful. Steep learning curve but very rewarding once everything works on a design. Like others, this game is what drove me into rocketry engineering in real life and I have not regretted it for a moment. 

Infinite replayability with the game's sandbox nature and the many many mods that have come out over the years. CKAN mod manager makes modding easy too which is a plus. The game engine is showing its age but still worth your money especially with the Breaking Ground DLC. Game also regularly goes on sale for $10 or less. 

If you love rockets, planes, rovers, or just space in general then please give this game a try and who knows, it might set you down a path that you least expect as it did with me. And while I know Squad no longer owns the IP I still thank them from the bottom of my heart to this day for helping shape who I have become and pushing me towards a goal that I genuinely enjoy.

This game is incredible. It's quite sad about it's sequel, but KSP 1 us still very good!

Downloading mods is almost a must. If there is something you want to see in the game, there is probably a mod for it.

It is a very good game. After years of development, this game platform is enough to undertake most of the simulation. If you need high-precision simulation calculation, you can find a large number of modules that meet your requirements in the mature community. The future development should be the official and community to increase the integration and adaptability of the modules, especially The compatibility between modules and the compatibility of modules and versions. If this game is not supported by the mod, it will become a piece of garbage. The module management function of Ckan is very useful. All kinds of commissioned rockets in the creative workshop may not be suitable for your version and environment, so be careful when using them. It is highly recommended to use artificial intelligence to help manage and test documents, and even assist in rocket development.

single_points.text: One reviewer says that playing on a Mac causes every mod to break half the time.

citation.review_text: This is the best space game ever, its easy to learn and you can do crazier things as you progress. but there is just one thing i don not recommend, and this comes straight from personal experience and to prevent you from wanting to break you computer. DO NOT PLAY ON A MAC BECAUSE EVERY MOD BREAKS HALF THE TIME, and you either spend 5 hours to get it working, or even more to realize there was never an option for this mod to work because no one likes apple silicon or MacOS or anything apple related because why not. anyways, highly recommend 10/10
